entities.summary: Nasir, a notable figure in the history of Maldives, associated with Nasir and Gayoom Authoritarian Era (1968–1978). Preceded by Nasir Presidency and Tourism Birth. Their legacy influenced Indian military Operation Cactus foils a mercenary coup attempt against Gayoom and Democracy Movement and Transition.
